subject.title: feat(state): Cloudflare-canonical exact-review records (state-repo retirement, phase 1)

question: Should phase 1 make Cloudflare Durable Object SQLite the production authority for exact-review records now, with Git retained only as a materialized projection?
rationale: This is a durable-state and operational-boundary decision: the patch intentionally retires Git as the write authority, and source-level tests cannot establish the acceptable upgrade, rollback, and operational recovery contract.

options.title: Require migration and recovery proof
options.body: Keep the intended Durable Object authority, but require a staged deployment or representative state snapshot showing upgrade, delayed materialization, retry, and reconciliation before merge.

options.title: Accept the authority change now
options.body: Merge with the stated test coverage and explicitly accept the operational migration and recovery risk for phase 1.

options.title: Retain Git as authority
options.body: Pause this phase and redesign the change so Durable Object storage remains a cache or queue until the retirement direction is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Require migration and recovery proof
recommendation.body: Keep the intended Durable Object authority, but require a staged deployment or representative state snapshot showing upgrade, delayed materialization, retry, and reconciliation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available metadata connects steipete directly to the proposed state-authority design; no stronger current-main ownership trail could be read in this environment.
